Oil vs Water

Dissolvable Products

Choosing between oil-based and water-based dissolvable CBD powders is pivotal for optimal absorption. Water-based CBD powders excel in terms of bioavailability. Due to the water-centric composition of the human body, water-soluble CBD is absorbed more readily, ensuring swifter and more potent effects. This efficient absorption means that the body gets maximum benefit from CBD.

  • Rapid absorption for immediate effect
  • Higher bioavailability than oil-based powders
  • Maximizes the beneficial impact of CBD

Selecting water-based dissolvable CBD powder offers an advanced approach to CBD consumption, ensuring that you reap the full benefits in a convenient, easily consumable form.

settings.title: Why should I choose CBD powder?
settings.text: Choosing CBD powder has several benefits. It's highly versatile and can be added to various food and drinks, making it a convenient way to consume CBD. CBD powder is often water-soluble, meaning it has higher bioavailability and can be absorbed more efficiently by the body. It's ideal for those who dislike the taste of CBD oil and prefer a flavorless option. Powders can also be measured precisely, allowing for accurate dosing tailored to individual needs.

settings.title: How much CBD powder should I use?
settings.text: The amount of CBD powder to use will depend on the dose per sachet. You should always start with the recommended daily dosage on the packaging. When starting a CBD regimen, we recommend beginning with 10-20mg of CBD per day for the first week to ensure it is well tolerated. You can then gradually increase your daily dose by increments of 5mg until you find your optimal dose, depending on what feels best for you. Successful customers often report that a daily maximum of 80-120mg (30-40 mgs, 2-3 times per day) works best. We recommend giving it 4-6 weeks at your maximum dose to determine if the supplements are effective for your needs. Additionally, we recommend taking our CBD with food to enhance absorption by the body.

settings.title: How much water should I use with CBD powder?
settings.text: The amount of liquid to use with your CBD powder depends on the type of product. For example, NextEvo Naturals' Caliper Berry Swiftsticks require no liquids and can be sprinkled directly on the tongue. Our Flavorless Dissolvable CBD powder, on the other hand, can be mixed into any food or beverage, hot or cold. You do not need to measure a specific amount of liquid out to mix your powder in, simply empty a sachet into your glass of water or other beverage, stir, and enjoy!

settings.title: Is dissolvable CBD powder the same strength as CBD gummies?
settings.text: Dissolvable CBD powder and gummies may have different strengths depending on the product and dosage. It's important to follow the recommended dosage instructions provided by NextEvo Naturals to ensure you're getting the desired effects. Our customer service team is available to help answer any questions you may have. Dissolvable powder is designed for faster-acting effects, whereas gummies can provide a convenient and discreet way to consume CBD. It's important to choose high-quality and lab-tested products to ensure their safety and potency.
